decision: Accept the intercept-control implementation with deterministic coverage across the existing families and bounded CPU sampling evidence for one Gaussian example at target_accept0.99. Preserve original0.9failure and limits; no default change. Merge only after final documentation checks.
preserved_failures: Original0.9PyMC3/NumPyro6divergences and MCSErunnerTypeError remain unchanged. No thresholds weakened.
limits: One Gaussian development example; no scientific calibration, rare-tail guarantee, all-family sampling coverage or GPU validation.
Single-hit NumPyro lower-tail estimate remains descriptive, not a reliable MCSE accuracy gate.
No change to library default target_accept; users must inspect diagnostics.
